mentions.name: T2 Mapper
mentions.description: A web-based viewer and editor for Tribes 2 maps that translates mission object trees from Torque .mis files into a Three.js scene graph. It runs the same TorqueScript the game uses to load missions, from server.cs's CreateServer() onward, via a TorqueScript transpiler and runtime, aiming to match Tribes 2's rendering and support live editing of missions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm now doing the same thing for Tribes 2 maps: trying to make a web-based map viewer and editor: https://exogen.github.io/t2-mapper/ (editing/creation part still in progress)
